    Weight-homogeneous lifts (Proposition 10.1, weight refinement) #

    integral-deformations.tex: "All these constructions can be chosen to preserve the simultaneous integer weights: […] the corrections can be chosen in each weight component."

    Given finitely many integer weight gradings on Λ = A⁽²⁾, Λ' = A⁽⁴⁾ and a module M, compatible with the reduction, the action, the homogeneous bases and the internal degree, the module lift of exists_liftMod can be chosen with an action homogeneous for every weight (exists_liftMod_weights), and the arrow lifts of exists_liftHom homogeneous for every weight (exists_liftHom_weights). The corrections come from extVanish_weights1 and extVanish_weights0; the arbitrary lifts through homogeneous bases are homogeneous for every weight by the same computation as for the degree.
